summaryZh: John Wixted记忆实验室研究再认与信心判断的形式模型、人类海马情景记忆及目击证词的可靠性。它将信号检测模型与实验、神经和现场数据结合，并使用临床监测中癫痫患者的单神经元记录检验情景记忆模型。
researchQuestions: 记忆强度与决策标准如何影响再认及信心判断？
记忆科学如何帮助评估目击证据？

evidence.quote: Our work spans the full arc of memory research: developing formal models of recognition and confidence, linking memory processes to activity in individual neurons in the human hippocampus, and applying memory science to improve the evaluation of eyewitness evidence in the legal system. A central goal is to integrate signal detection–based models of memory with empirical data from laboratory, neural, and field settings.
We test predictions from neurocomputational models of episodic memory using single-unit recordings from epilepsy patients undergoing clinical monitoring
Affiliation Department of Psychology University of California, San Diego
We develop signal detection–based models of memory strength, decision criteria, and confidence judgments, with applications ranging from controlled laboratory tasks to real-world settings.
